title: 22 September 1961: Live: Knotty Ash Village Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ second performance at the Village Hall on East Prestcot Road, Knotty Ash, Liverpool.

The show was booked by Mona Best, mother of Pete Best, who promoted beat music events at the Casbah Coffee Club and other venues around Liverpool.

The Beatles performed at the Knotty Ash Village Hall on eight occasions. The other dates were 15 and 29 September; 20 and 27 October; 10 and 17 November 1961; and 17 March 1962. The last of these was promoted by Sam Leach, who took over the venue from Mona Best earlier that year.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
